Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Sorren Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren - Original NPC[/url] mod NPC Sorren, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.

Find where you installed your Sorren mod (somewhere in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the "[b]assets[/b]" folder to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Sorren Original NPC\assets[/b] folder to overwrite it for it to work. 

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren - Original NPC[/url]﻿ mod.)
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

I might overdid the wrinkles so if you want him to look younger download the version with less wrinkles.

The character Sorren belongs to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4040]Sorren - Original NPC[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33710235]annachibi2[/url]﻿, please go give them Endorsements and loves.

1.01: Edited the eyes a bit.
13/08: Uploaded content patcher version.

08/25/2021: Uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version.
For people who prefer to install them in Portraiture or having people disappearing issues in 64bit version game.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] mod doesn't officially supports 64bit game yet so it tends to broke under 64 bit, if you are using 64 bit and the other version doesn't work for you please try install it with Portraiture(or the CP version).
